name: Yeti Battle of Greenhat Peak
review:
Yeti Battle of Greenhat Peak is an 11-line mountain slot with wilds, Wild Attack spins and a bonus with sticky wilds.

Thunderkick rates it Low volatility, with an 845x cap and a 96.1% RTP.

Wild Attack spins can drop extra wilds in the base game, and the bonus adds sticky wilds. Low volatility and frosty cartoon art make it an easy-going choice.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
